name: clew
description: Index a C, C++, Rust or Python repository into a queryable graph — symbols, call edges, callbacks, threads, locks, dataflow, requirement links and prose — and serve it over MCP. Installs four tools AND one PostToolUse hook that names the file you just inspected and the one index call that would have answered more, escalating while it goes unused and going silent again once the index is used (disable with CLEW_HOOK_DISABLE=1). Requires the clew-trace package on PATH and the doxygen binary.
